test_self_consistency_basics: test the SelfConsistency class wraps a strategy to return a distribution over answers with ExtractConsensus
test_self_consistency_output_filter: test SelfConsistency with a custom output filter that removes None-valued samples from the result distribution
test_self_consistency_scorer: test SelfConsistency with a custom scorer that ranks samples by numeric suffix and returns weighted distribution
test_self_consistency_bucketizer: test SelfConsistency with a custom bucketizer that groups outputs by trailing integer modulo 2
test_self_consistency_representative_out: test SelfConsistency with a custom representative output selector that picks highest-scoring answer per bucket
